prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, close on a thin bald gangster with big ears in a sweat-soaked vest and pinstripe trousers, his real-skinned face large in frame and off-centre right, lit orange by an open furnace at the left edge, squinting into the heat, sweat beading on his scalp, a shovel heaped with blank green paper money with no printing raised to his chest. Behind him in the dark, the gleam of a fat copper pipe climbing the brick wall. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the firelight on his face and the notes. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
